title: Tiffin Tracker Update
message: Update with clean zero-mock architecture, persistent login, and real-time Firebase sync!
releaseNotes: Zero mock data: clean slate architecture for new flat rooms
Persistent login sessions: no more being kicked out to gate
Instant room creation and member joins synced directly to Firebase
Strict single-vote deduplication across devices (app vs web)
Clean, clutter-free in-app UX without popup banners
